text:
Maya Nguyen: Heads-up — HelixCare onboarding call tomorrow. They've surfaced a short list of product + billing friction we should capture into discrete tickets so Product can triage quickly.
Jamal Ortiz: I took notes. Main items: per-route billing mismatch, stale embeddings hurting search, dashboard timeouts on long-range queries.
Otis Lane: Drop the raw quotes here and I'll convert into our tracker CSV format.
Maya Nguyen: Raw snippets below. Please bucket by theme and add a severity label. If we surface >3 high-impact blockers, mark as renewal risk and loop Priya. @Priya Shah FYI.
```
"We can't reconcile cost per route — numbers don't match our invoices." — Jaime (Billing Manager)
"Embeddings are stale; search misses our latest SKU updates." — Rachel (Catalog Lead)
"Dashboard times out when we try to pull 90-day usage." — Sam (Ops)
"Need a per-environment toggle for embeddings refresh cadence." — Jaime
```
Priya Shah: Quick question: HelixCare contract size? Priority differs for SMB vs mid-market.
Jamal Ortiz: Mid-market, ~45k ARR. Onboarding has been delayed ~3 weeks; NPS trending down. Jaime called out renewal concern if billing clarity isn't improved.
Maya Nguyen: Renewal risk = medium-high. Short-term recommendation: expose per-route billing toggle/workaround in UI + a long-term reconciliation view for finance.
Otis Lane: I'll prepare the CSV schema for import. Columns: customer, user_quote, theme, severity, impact_notes, suggested_owner. Jamal, can you map the quotes into that schema?
Jamal Ortiz: On it. I'll upload a sample CSV to #cs-uploads. Sample rows:
```csv
customer,user_quote,theme,severity,impact_notes,suggested_owner
HelixCare,"We can't reconcile cost per route",billing,high,"Finance can't forecast costs accurately","Product: billing-ux"
HelixCare,"Embeddings are stale; search misses our latest SKU updates",embeddings,medium,"Search relevance down ~20%","Eng-ml: embeddings-refresh"
HelixCare,"Dashboard times out when we pull 90-day usage",performance,low,"Occurs during peak export windows","Eng-infra: dashboard-timeouts"
```
Priya Shah: If we can get the top 3 themes with severity and a proposed owner by EOD, I'll slot a lightweight ticket into next week's roadmap sync.
Maya Nguyen: Plan: Jamal finishes CSV and posts, Otis drafts a one-pager for the workaround, Priya assesses roadmap priority. I'll ask CSMs to surface any other blockers before EOD.
Otis Lane: I'll own the workaround PR (per-route billing toggle) and validate the UX with Jaime.
Jamal Ortiz: CSV uploaded to #cs-uploads: https://redwood-slack.fake/cs-uploads/helixcare-onboard-snippets.csv :paperclip:  (file contains the mapped rows)
Priya Shah: Reviewing now. Will reply with priority + estimated effort by 17:30.
Maya Nguyen: This capture format works well for mid-market onboarding issues — short quote, explicit theme, severity, and one owner. :thumbsup:
feedback-bot: Ticket created: PROD-FB-5678 (HelixCare onboarding bucketed)
Otis Lane: Noted. I'll follow up on the PR first thing tomorrow.
Jamal Ortiz: If Product needs clarification from Jaime, ping me — I can schedule a 15-min call.
Priya Shah: EOD deliverables acknowledged.
Maya Nguyen: Closing thread. I'll update the renewal tracker after roadmap sync and tag any exec stakeholders if risk changes.
